plugins.name: site-audit-kit
plugins.description: Guard-railed technical SEO audits of your own website: an SSRF-safe fetcher with a host allowlist, a read-only SQL guard for WordPress databases, a supervised Screaming Frog MCP crawl with health checks and a hard time limit, an export redactor with a fail-closed check, and a run manifest that pins everything before an audit starts. Standard-library Python, fully tested, configured by one JSON file; with no config the tools allow no hosts.
